notes.title: Where Winds Meet is Set to Launch on November 14th, 2025
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45573336/fa050588dea315abe0d7c18e1a3e4b10b595c54b.png"][/img][/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that[i] WhereWinds Meet [/i]launches globally on November 14th, 2025 on PC and PlayStation 5. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="PB0i3293jRQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Set during the turbulent era of tenth-century China, you take on the role of a young sword master, uncovering forgotten truths and the mysteries of your own identity. As the wind stirs across mountains and rivers, so too will your legend rise.[/p][list][*][p]Forge your legend in the wuxia world[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Explore an immersive wuxia open-world inspired by ancient martial arts fantacy[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience combat that flows like true martial artistry[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our vision is to create a world of pure freedom, where you can live the dream of Jianghu in your own way— without limits, without barriers. You can embark on a rich, narrative driven single player adventure with over 150 hours of gameply, open your world to up to 4 friends in seamless co-op, or step into a shared, ever-evolving world with thousands of fellow adventurers.[/p][p]We can't wait to share this world with you. Mark your calendars! Your story begins November 14, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]For more information, visit the game’s official website:[/p][p][url="https://www.wherewindsmeetgame.com/"]https://www.wherewindsmeetgame.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Follow our socials to learn more:
[url="https://x.com/WhereWindsMeet_"]X[/url]|[url="https://www.facebook.com/WhereWindsMeet"]Facebook[/url]|[url="https://www.instagram.com/where_winds_meet/"]Instagram[/url]|[url="https://www.youtube.com/@WhereWindsMeet"]Youtube[/url]|[url="https://discord.gg/eQc47PbWCK"]Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: The Final Test Begins!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Peep-peep! Hello Legends,
Thank you for your enthusiasm and support! The Final Test is officially live now![/p][p]
[b]\[Test Details][/b]
This is a limited, free-to-play, closed beta available on PC and PlayStation. The current game is still in the development and refinement stage, and the test content does not represent the final quality of the game.[/p][p]
[b]\[Test Schedule][/b]
Beijing: July 25 10:00 to Aug 1 12:00（UTC+8）
New York: July 24 at 22:00 p.m. ET to Aug 1 at 00:00 a.m. ET
Tokyo: July 25 11:00 (JST) to Aug 1 13:00 (JST)
Seoul: July 25 11:00 (KST) to Aug 1 13:00 (KST)[/p][p]
[b]\[How to Log In][/b]
PC: Redeem your steam beta code and download the game.[/p][p]
[b]\[What's Available][/b]
Open World: All Qinghe region and most areas of Kaifeng region (including related Fragment Chapters and Campaigns).
Main Story: Till the first half of Chapter 2.
Modes: Solo Mode, Co-op Mode & Online Mode.[/p][p]
[b]\[Reminders][/b]
To ensure a smooth testing experience, please note:
1. Test access is strictly personal and non-transferable. Any form of trading or transferring test qualifications is prohibited. For any violation detected, we reserve the right to revoke access and take further action. Please beware of any unauthorized sale or sharing of test accounts or installation files to avoid losses. Thank you for your understanding.
2. Test qualifications are tied exclusively to your registered platform and device; platform switching is not supported during the closed beta.
3. The use of cheats, hacks, or any third-party tools that compromise game fairness is strictly forbidden. Violations may result in penalties including removal of illicit gains, account suspension, or bans.
4. Please avoid firmware updates or system reinstalls on your test device during the closed beta.
5. Controller support is available, but some menus and gameplay features may not be fully optimized for it yet. If you encounter unresponsive controls, please switch to keyboard and mouse. We appreciate your patience.[/p][p]
[b]\[To Know More][/b][/p][p]For test-related FAQs, please visit our official website: [/p][p][url="https://www.wherewindsmeet.com"]www.wherewindsmeet.com[/url][/p][/td][/tr][/table][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]
If you have any question or suggestion, please reach out via in-game Feedback button or join our official Discord group.

Where Winds Meet Team[/p][/td][/tr][/table]
